hypothesis.primary: Routed-HMSA has lower fixed-epoch macro MAE than Direct-Residual-Blocked on the independent SummEval confirmation test.
hypothesis.mechanism: Orthogonal-only retains a favorable difference relative to Direct-Residual-Blocked, whereas Parallel-only does not reproduce that improvement.

training.precision: bfloat16 model/gradient storage with FP32 losses and FP64 projection reductions

resource_amendment.timing: before any formal checkpoint or development result existed
resource_amendment.invariant: effective batch size remains 112; epochs, data order, learning rate, objective, clipping, and all evaluation rules are unchanged
resource_amendment.reason: the maximum 230-token input left the RTX 3090 substantially underutilized

evaluation.primary_metric: macro average of coherence and fluency expected-score MAE
evaluation.uncertainty: paired source-article-cluster bootstrap after averaging paired per-record errors across five seeds
evaluation.training_seed_uncertainty: report all five paired seed differences and mean plus sample standard deviation
evaluation.development_use: implementation validity only; no arm, epoch, or hyperparameter selection

test_access.rule: one-time evaluation only after all 20 fixed-epoch checkpoints exist and pass integrity checks
